name: Stiff Leg Deficit Deadlift
instructions: Set up for the Stiff Leg Deficit Deadlift with a barbell. Stand tall with your core braced.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back while keeping a flat back and a slight knee bend.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, squeezing your glutes at the top without leaning back.
longevityNotes: Hip-hinge strength protects the lower back in every lift, from groceries to grandchildren. Strong glutes and hamstrings are the engine of walking, climbing, and standing up.
overview: Stiff Leg Deficit Deadlift is a intermediate hinge exercise for the hamstrings and glutes, performed with a barbell.
